verdict.rationale: Square documents API Explorer, an interactive web app for building, viewing, and sending HTTP requests against real Sandbox or production resources such as customers, orders, and catalog objects. A hosted GraphQL Explorer also runs queries against Sandbox or production, and API Logs show each request and response. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of pre-populated runnable example requests or generated code snippets embedded in the reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
